messages.snippet: Tom, Elena - on the advice note, make sure we're clear that prosecution risk is low IF we notify now
messages.subject: CV-7 advice note - exposure section
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom, Elena - on the advice note, make sure we're clear that prosecution risk is low IF we notify now and run an effective recall, and flag the one-week dealer mis-coding delay so the board sees we've considered it. Also a line on directors' duties (s172/174) and a recommendation to notify insurers. I'll review this afternoon.

Sarah

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.snippet: Daniel, Nina - our advice note is in your board pack. Headline: treat as safety-related, notify DVSA
messages.subject: CV-7 - advice note for this morning's board
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Nina - our advice note is in your board pack. Headline: treat as safety-related, notify DVSA now, run a proactive voluntary recall; prosecution risk low if we act promptly; notify insurers within the policy window. We recommend the board formally resolve to authorise the notification and recall - draft minute attached to the pack.

We'll dial in for items 1-4.

Sarah

—

22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
